text:
Big suitcase, Narita, hotel in Shinjuku.
The train is faster. The bus saves you the walk 👇

🅰️ Narita Express
87 minutes, ¥3,330.
Lifts come out at the south gates.

🅱️ Limousine bus
About 115 minutes, ¥3,600.
Stops about 200 m from north-side hotels.

💡 How we decide
Hotel near the South Exit? Take A.
North side, big case, bus soon? Take B.

👉 The full trace with each distance:
https://japanbystation.com/shinjuku-five-minutes-with-a-suitcase
